channel_creation_requests_decided_check.name: channel_creation_requests_decided_check
channel_creation_requests_decided_check.value: "channel_creation_requests"."status" = 'pending' or ("channel_creation_requests"."decided_at" is not null and "channel_creation_requests"."decided_by" is not null)

channels_department_purpose_check.name: channels_department_purpose_check
channels_department_purpose_check.value: "channels"."purpose" not in ('department', 'announcement') or ("channels"."department_id" is not null and "channels"."visibility" = 'public')

user_role_assignments_scope_check.name: user_role_assignments_scope_check
user_role_assignments_scope_check.value: ("user_role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'company' and "user_role_assignments"."department_id" is null) or ("user_role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'department' and "user_role_assignments"."department_id" is not null)
